exposure: new clinical classification system and therapeutic strategy for cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: A total of 331 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) at the study hospital.
finding: The new clinical classification system and therapeutic strategy for CSP significantly reduced intraoperative blood loss, operative time, hospital stay, and hospital cost compared to conventional methods.
mod_finding: The study focuses on treating Cesarean Scar Pregnancy, a complication directly resulting from previous cesarean births.
